summary: The one security-relevant risk surfaced in review — a third-party MCP tool spoofing the correlation invocationId via its own result payload — is closed: result-metadata extraction is restricted to the private _meta.invocationId path AND gated on trusted registration provenance (host allowed-tools + reserved mcp__gantry__ namespace / registered-tool marker), so a third-party tool can never be classed Gantry-owned by name (decision 0132). Caller-visible browser/capability result shape is unchanged; no _meta clobbering; no secret leakage in recorded detail (bounded, redacted capability audit summary).
residual_risks: Gantry correlation depends on MCP result _meta surviving the SDK round-trip (spec-supported, our own tool's metadata); documented in decision 0132.
